events.title: Southern Lights Holiday Festival
events.blurb: The drive-through holiday light show at the Kentucky Horse Park opens for the season on Friday. It's one price per car, online or at the gate.
events.blurbEs: El espectáculo de luces navideñas que se recorre en auto en el Kentucky Horse Park abre la temporada el viernes. Se paga un precio por auto, en línea o en la entrada.

events.title: Kentucky Wildcats vs. Louisville Cardinals
events.blurb: The Governor's Cup rivalry kicks off at noon Saturday on ESPN2. It's also Senior Day and a Blue Out.
events.blurbEs: El clásico por la Governor's Cup arranca el sábado al mediodía por ESPN2. También es el Senior Day y un Blue Out.

events.title: Kentucky Wildcats vs. Wichita State Shockers
events.blurb: UK men's basketball hosts Wichita State on Black Friday night, tipping off at 9 p.m. on ESPN2.
events.blurbEs: El baloncesto masculino de UK recibe a Wichita State el viernes negro por la noche, con salto inicial a las 9 p.m. por ESPN2.

events.title: Black Stone Cherry
events.blurb: The Kentucky hard-rock band plays an all-ages show in the Distillery District. Doors open at 7 p.m.
events.blurbEs: La banda de hard rock de Kentucky da un concierto para todas las edades en el Distillery District. Las puertas abren a las 7 p.m.

events.title: Trish Suhr
events.blurb: Stand-up from Trish Suhr, with three shows over two nights. There is a one-drink minimum.
events.blurbEs: Comedia en vivo con Trish Suhr, con tres funciones en dos noches. Hay un consumo mínimo de una bebida.

events.title: The Best Christmas Pageant Ever: The Musical
events.blurb: Lexington Children's Theatre opens its holiday musical on Sunday. It runs through December 6.
events.blurbEs: Lexington Children's Theatre estrena su musical navideño el domingo. Sigue en cartelera hasta el 6 de diciembre.

events.title: The Arboretum, State Botanical Garden of Kentucky
events.blurb: Free gardens and walking paths on UK's campus, open daily from dawn to dusk.
events.blurbEs: Jardines y senderos gratis en el campus de UK, abiertos todos los días del amanecer al anochecer.
